findings.evidence: Line 96 `theorem intervalIntegrable_mul_sub {K φ : ℝ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}` with conclusion `IntervalIntegrable (fun z => K z * (φ z - φ 1)) volume 0 1`; line 121 `theorem intervalIntegrable_inv_one_sub_mul_sub`. Naming conventions: "the name of theorem simply describes the conclusion" — the conclusion here is tied to `plusFunctional K φ` (line 76), not to an arbitrary `f * (g - c)`.
findings.fix: Rename to names that mention the object, e.g. `intervalIntegrable_plusFunctional_integrand` / `intervalIntegrable_plusOneMinus_integrand` (or at least `intervalIntegrable_mul_sub_apply_one`), and update the two docstring references at lines 33 and 74 and the call at line 125.
findings.issue: `intervalIntegrable_mul_sub` (and `intervalIntegrable_inv_one_sub_mul_sub`, line 121) name a statement that is specific to the plus-functional integrand — the subtracted value is `φ 1`, pinned to the right endpoint of `0..1` — but read as general facts about `f * (g - c)` being interval integrable, and they are the only declarations in the file whose names do not mention the plus functional at all. The docstring calls the first one "Convergence of the plus functional", so a consumer searching the API for that theorem will not find it by name.

findings.evidence: Line 132 `theorem plusFunctional_const (K : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : plusFunctional K (fun _ => c) = 0` vs lines 141/147 `plusFunctional_smul_left (c • K) φ` / `plusFunctional_smul_right K (c • φ)`; Mathlib disambiguates bilinear slots the same way (`inner_zero_left`/`inner_zero_right`).
findings.fix: Rename to `plusFunctional_const_right`. `plusOneMinus_const` (line 137) needs no change — `plusOneMinus` has only one slot, and the name matches the roadmap's `Suggested.lean`.
findings.issue: `plusFunctional_const` has no slot marker, while the file disambiguates the two arguments everywhere else (`plusFunctional_smul_left`/`_smul_right`, `_add_left`/`_add_right`, `_mul_right`). By analogy with `plusFunctional_smul_left` the bare name reads as the kernel slot, i.e. `plusFunctional (fun _ => c) φ`, which is not zero in general; the lemma is about the test-function slot.

summary: Definitions and most lemma names follow the roadmap's suggested names and describe their conclusions correctly; no notation is introduced and the EpsilonEridani namespace is right. Two names are misleading: the file's headline convergence theorems carry generic `intervalIntegrable_mul_sub`-style names that advertise a general product-of-difference integrability fact, and `plusFunctional_const` omits the slot marker the rest of the file uses.
